usage: Generate candidate 900x900 instrument artwork only after checking real references. Every generated image must remain blocked until reviewed by a knowledgeable Chinese orchestra musician or administrator.

global_style.format: single instrument centered, 900x900 PNG, clean warm neutral background, realistic teaching-reference product image
do_not_include: performer hands that hide the instrument morphology

prompts.prompt: Realistic product-style teaching reference image of a Chinese gehu, a large low bowed Chinese orchestra bass instrument. Show a cello-like seated/standing low bowed instrument with a large resonating body, long neck, endpin or low support, bowed string setup, warm wood finish, accurate proportions. Single instrument only, centered, neutral background, 900x900.
prompts.negative_prompt: Do not make it look like erhu, zhonghu, banhu, violin, viola, western cello copy with no Chinese orchestra character, fantasy instrument, or tiny huqin.
required_positive_terms: large low bowed Chinese orchestra instrument
must_show_checklist: large resonator body with Chinese orchestra character
must_not_show_checklist: plain western cello with no Chinese morphology

prompts.prompt: Realistic product-style teaching reference image of a traditional Chinese suona. Show a short conical wooden body, finger holes, small double reed mouthpiece at the top, and a flared metal bell at the bottom. The bell-to-body proportion should clearly read as suona. Single instrument only, centered, neutral background, 900x900.
prompts.negative_prompt: Do not make it look like trumpet, saxophone, western oboe, clarinet, bugle, fantasy brass, or a long metal horn.
must_show_checklist: small double reed and bocal at the top
detachable flared metal bell at the bottom

prompts.prompt: Realistic product-style teaching reference image of a Chinese sheng mouth organ. Show many vertical bamboo or metal pipes inserted into a rounded wind chest, with a clear angled mouthpiece. Pipes have different heights and are arranged in a cluster. Single instrument only, centered, neutral background, 900x900.
prompts.negative_prompt: Do not make it look like panpipes, pipe organ, bagpipe, fantasy pipe cluster, or generic bamboo decoration.
required_positive_terms: many vertical pipes of varied heights
must_show_checklist: many vertical pipes of varied heights
pipes inserted into a wind chest
mouthpiece attached to the wind chest

prompts.prompt: Realistic product-style teaching reference image of a Chinese banhu. Show a huqin-family bowed instrument with a bright small resonator, wooden soundboard or coconut/wood shell body, two strings, long neck, pegs, and bow. Make the resonator visibly different from erhu snakeskin resonator. Single instrument only, centered, neutral background, 900x900.
prompts.negative_prompt: Do not make it a generic erhu, gaohu, zhonghu, violin, or lute. Do not use a snakeskin erhu resonator as the main visual.
must_show_checklist: small resonator with wooden board sound surface
coconut shell or wood-shell body character
must_not_show_checklist: snakeskin-covered erhu resonator as the main identity

prompts.prompt: Realistic product-style teaching reference image of a standard Chinese erhu. Show a small hexagonal or round snakeskin-covered resonator, long slender neck, two tuning pegs, two strings, and bow hair passing between the strings. Single instrument only, centered, neutral background, 900x900.
prompts.negative_prompt: Do not make it oversized like zhonghu, tiny like gaohu, or low bass-like gehu. Do not omit the bow relationship to the two strings.
must_show_checklist: bow hair between the two strings

prompts.prompt: Realistic product-style teaching reference image of a Chinese gaohu. Show a smaller, higher-register huqin-family instrument with a small resonator, slender neck, two strings and bow, visually more compact and brighter than erhu. Single instrument only, centered, neutral background, 900x900.
prompts.negative_prompt: Do not make it identical to erhu or zhonghu. Do not make the resonator large or bass-like.
must_show_checklist: small resonator, visibly smaller than erhu
must_not_show_checklist: same size as erhu without differentiation

prompts.prompt: Realistic product-style teaching reference image of a Chinese zhonghu. Show a lower-register huqin-family instrument with a larger resonator and more robust proportions than erhu, long neck, two strings and bow. Single instrument only, centered, neutral background, 900x900.
prompts.negative_prompt: Do not make it tiny like gaohu, identical to erhu, or as large as gehu. Avoid generic violin-family shapes.
must_show_checklist: more robust body and neck proportions

approval_gate: Candidate output is not app-ready until import_approved_artwork.py validates professional approval metadata.
